title: SEED official held-out WebShop comparison: frozen OpenEvo SD-LoRA vs BASE vs SEED paper-reported reference
objective: Produce one credible, auditable local estimate of the frozen, reproduced OpenEvo Qwen2.5-7B policy on SEED's official held-out WebShop task space, placed next to the SEED paper-reported reference, without any SEED training or OpenEvo retraining.
scientific_question: On SEED's official held-out WebShop task space (env.seed=0, goal_idx 0-499), how does our strongest frozen reproduced OpenEvo policy perform on raw task_score and exact success, and how far is it from the SEED paper-reported result (89.7 score / 78.1% success)?

benchmark.name: WebShop small (official held-out)
benchmark.goal_ordering: seed-dependent; SimServer random.seed(env_seed)+shuffle at construction; reset(session=goal_idx) selects goals[goal_idx]

seed_paper_reference.role: paper-reported reference ONLY; not locally reproduced
seed_paper_reference.must_be_labeled: SEED paper-reported / reported by SEED Table 1

primary.name: SEED-strict public-code inference contract (identical for both arms)
primary.prompt_source: byte-exact SEED @2cf2fad WEBSHOP_TEMPLATE / WEBSHOP_TEMPLATE_NO_HIS; history_length=valid_len; >20000 chars -> NO_HIS
primary.history: SimpleMemory format [Observation n: 'obs', Action n: 'act']; records are (pre-step reformatted obs, projected action); history_length=2
primary.parser: webshop_projection verbatim; PASS-THROUGH (invalid projected action sent to env, no substitution/repair)
primary.top_k: disabled (HF neutralized to vocab_size 151936 to match vLLM top_k=-1)
primary.generation_seed: 2026082500 + panel_ordinal (frozen, identical across arms for the same task); per-step + step_index
primary.evaluator: WebShop raw task_score (continuous, terminal) + exact success (won == done and task_score==1.0), saved separately

diagnostic.name: OpenEvo-native inference contract (secondary; does NOT enter the comparison table)
diagnostic.role: near-zero-cost pre-registered diagnostic; decided before results

task_selection.priority: Priority-2 outcome-blind deterministic (Priority-1 exact paper identities unrecoverable: validation RandomState advances per call)
task_selection.selection_basis: SEED first-validation draw (env.seed+1000); draw order preserved as panel order
task_selection.label: SEED-compatible official-held-out 128-task panel

qualification.qualification_pool: synthetic bounded generation OR train-pool goal_idx 5500 and 6500 (frozen, >=500)
checks: reward wrapper raw task_score + exact success retained

analysis.primary_estimand: OPEN_EVO_SD minus BASE paired contrast on identical held-out task identities
analysis.seed_paper_gap: numerical gap only; NOT a paired statistical contrast; no paired bootstrap vs paper

resources.gpu_model: single GPU per arm; the two arms may run in parallel on two authorized live-idle GPUs (Amendment 2026-08-25, user directive "必须用6+7两块"). Default is one GPU sequential. Scientific contract is GPU-count-agnostic.
resources.authorized_gpu_uuids_source: parent experiment-execution-policy.md standing RTX 5090 pool intersected with immediate live-idle at launch
resources.parallel_execution_amendment_20260825: Explicit user directive "必须用6+7两块" authorizes running BASE on GPU-461c7a33 (index 6) and OPEN_EVO_SD on GPU-fb620174 (index 7) concurrently, each GPU running primary then diagnostic for its arm. GPU 7 was verified free (2 MiB / 0% util, no compute apps, no container bound to its UUID) before authorization. Episodes are independent and deterministic (frozen per-task generation_seed), so parallel execution does not change any measurement; total GPU-hours are unchanged and per-attempt UUID is recorded.

tracking.offline_fallback: only after saved online probe failure and final spool hash

forbidden_changes: reporting global_step_1 SEED smoke checkpoint as SEED result
claim_boundary: Maximum supportable claim: On our frozen SEED-compatible official-held-out WebShop panel, the frozen OpenEvo Qwen2.5-7B policy obtains X task score and Y% exact success, compared with the SEED paper-reported reference of 89.7 score and 78.1% success. Because the exact paper evaluation denominator is unproven, must add: SEED value is paper-reported; SEED training/checkpoint was not locally reproduced. Forbidden claims: we reproduced SEED 89.7; exact apples-to-apples reproduction; OpenEvo universally worse/better; causal method difference from the cross-source gap.
next_gate: Qualify (zero held-out consumption) -> formal 256 primary + 256 diagnostic episodes -> reconcile/analyze -> closeout. If no authorized live-idle GPU, keep preregistered and stop with a resumable command.
